raw.query: SELECT metric_path, value_num FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE script = 'j_classes' AND metric_path LIKE 'burst_attribution_top6[%].shares.frames' ORDER BY metric_path;
raw.evidence: All 6 top burst episodes have frame shares that round to whole percentages within 93-96% (unrounded range: 92.71% to 96.43%).
